title: Chewbacca Roar
blurb: The Chewbacca roar — a Wookiee's full emotional range, assembled from bears, walruses, and badgers by Ben Burtt. It expresses frustration, affection, and mild disagreement using the same sound, which is honestly relatable. Play it when words fail and only a roar will do.
origin: Chewbacca's vocalisations from Star Wars, built from real animal recordings.
